intuition: Breadth-first traversal finds each level in order; alternate levels can write values from opposite ends of a result row.

brute_force.approach: Collect a normal level-order traversal, then reverse every other level afterward.

optimal.approach: Process one queue level at a time and place each value at its forward or reversed index.

edge_cases: An empty tree returns no levels.
A singleton level is unchanged by reversal.
